title: fix(app-shell): announce the route object-read and page record-load failures
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8MCjwDfBRBbh1qJBm2tbXAr)_

Part of #25915 (slice 3 of ruling B; slice 4, the retirement of `ViewSkeleton` / `ShimmerSkeleton`, is the PR that closes the card).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:控制台里两处"加载失败"画面(路由对象读取失败、自定义页面记录读取失败)改用共享的 `DataErrorState` 组件绘制。
- 为什么改:原来这两处用无 `role` 的 `Empty` 手绘,读屏软件在读取失败时什么都听不到;共享组件天生 `role="alert"`,失败会被播报,也与"空"区分开。
- 风险与回滚:只换呈现组件,文案、i18n 键、测试 id、重试按钮都不变;视觉上多一个红色小图标方块。回滚即还原这两个文件。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/PageView.tsx` 的失败分支;`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx` 的 `RouteObjectReadFailed`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/PageView.appPageRecord-12931.test.tsx`,预期全部通过,含新增的 `#25915` 用例。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `RouteObjectReadFailed` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`) and the page record-scope load failure (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/PageView.tsx`) render `DataErrorState` from `@object-ui/components` instead of a hand-drawn `Empty`. The failure node is now `role="alert"` by construction.
- Kept unchanged: the i18n keys and defaults (`list.loadErrorTitle` / `list.loadErrorMessage`, `empty.recordLoadFailed` / `empty.recordLoadFailedDescription`, `common.retry`), the test ids (`route-object-read-failed`, `page-record-load-failed` and their `-retry` buttons) and both Retry handlers.
- No new prop on the shared component: the test id spreads onto the root through `...props`, and Retry is passed as `children` (the component's documented slot for a call site's own control) rather than `onRetry`, so it keeps its own test id and, on the page, its icon. The shared default icon (destructive `AlertCircle` square) replaces the page block's muted `AlertTriangle`; `AlertTriangle` drops from the page's imports.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`, but its code ships inside the published `@object-ui/console` SPA, so the changeset bumps both as `patch` (the same pair recent app-shell fixes carry).

## Tests

- New pin in `AppContent.disabledPackageDeepLink-13052.test.tsx`: on a 5xx read the `route-object-read-failed` node has `role="alert"` and contains its Retry; Retry asks once more and the served object renders with no alert. The existing served-object CONTROL also asserts no alert.
- New pin in `PageView.appPageRecord-12931.test.tsx`: the failed read's node has `role="alert"` and contains Retry; Retry re-reads, the loaded row renders, and no alert remains.

## Acceptance notes

Other app-shell blocks that draw a load failure by hand (listed for the card; not moved here, per the order): `views/metadata-admin/AuditPanel.tsx` (`audit-error-state`, an `Empty`), `views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx` (`refs-error`, an `Empty`), `views/metadata-admin/DirectoryPage.tsx` (the `engine.directory.loadFailed` line, a bare `text-destructive` div), and `chrome/ErrorBoundary.tsx` (the boundary fallback, an `Empty`). `objectViewHeaderChrome.tsx` also has one but is under the `ObjectView*` exclusion.

## Verification

All readings at head `72976b7a` (base `eef83734`).

- The two touched files, under `os-verify-lock`: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` on both. VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 2 passed (2), Tests 23 passed (23).
- Ablation, with the fix committed: both source files reverted to `origin/main` (the `Empty` blocks: a `grep -c` for the `DataErrorState` JSX opener reads 0 in each file, and for the old `Empty` opener carrying the test id reads 1 in each). VERDICT command-exit 1, Tests 2 failed | 21 passed (23). The two `#25915` pins went red on `toHaveAttribute('role', 'alert')`, and every other test stayed green. Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`: both blob hashes equal `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Every app-shell test file that imports `AppContent` or `PageView` (56 files), under the lock: VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 56 passed (56), Tests 358 passed (358).
